summary: Verified the reported 'Transactions tab blank/white screen' bug REPRODUCED in the PREVIEW environment (not just production stale build). Root cause: BookTransactions.jsx used <DialogDescription> at line 231 but did NOT import it (only Dialog/DialogContent/DialogHeader/DialogTitle imported at line 6). This triggered ReferenceError: DialogDescription is not defined during render, exploding the whole BookTransactions component and showing the CRA red error overlay (blank underneath). Applied a one-line missing-import fix, then re-ran the full test-plan from the review request end-to-end. All 11 steps now pass with 0 uncaught page errors and 0 console errors/warnings.

Recommended: wrap the ops console content in a React ErrorBoundary so a single component crash does not blank the whole route (React already suggested this in the console warning we captured pre-fix).
critical_code_review_comments: BookTransactions.jsx: fixed missing DialogDescription import — this was the exact cause of the user-reported blank white screen. Regression risk lesson: JSX using an undefined identifier does not fail the webpack/CRA build; it only fails at render time.

No global ErrorBoundary in the ops console — a single broken tab's runtime error currently corrupts the whole view (only the CRA red overlay in dev; in production, an empty region). Consider wrapping /ops routes in an ErrorBoundary.

BookTransactions.jsx is 307 lines and mixes list, filters, dialog, edit, receipt upload — still readable, but nearing the split threshold; consider factoring the entry-dialog into its own component to reduce blast radius of edits like this one.

rca of the issue: REPRO: Log in admin -> /ops/bookkeeping -> click Transactions tab. React attempts to render BookTransactions which contains <DialogDescription ...> inside the Add/Edit dialog JSX subtree. Because DialogDescription was NOT in the import statement, the identifier resolves to undefined at render time, producing 'ReferenceError: DialogDescription is not defined' from BookTransactions in the React render stack (captured verbatim in the pre-fix screenshot). React unmounts the subtree and CRA overlays the runtime-errors panel — hence the user's blank/white screen. MITIGATION: Added DialogDescription to the named import from '@/components/ui/dialog' (which already exports it, verified in dialog.jsx lines 75-93). Post-fix verification: 0 pageerror, 0 console error/warn across all 11 review-request steps. Recommended defensive follow-ups: (1) ErrorBoundary around ops routes, (2) ESLint no-undef with React JSX globals to catch this at CI/build time.
